LG OLED evo G4 is known as the king of living room image display technology. Thanks to the ultra-thin monolithic design One Wall Design Completely flat, the TV when pressed tightly against the wall looks exactly like a living art painting in an exhibition room.

Using an OLED evo panel combined with Brightness Booster Max brightness enhancement technology, G4 provides 150% more brightness than conventional OLED TVs, providing an absolutely deep black range and breathtakingly brilliant colors. The new generation Alpha 11 AI processor automatically upscales all low-resolution video sources to near 4K standards.
